The calculator's inputs, read from the prediction schema

Source: R/calculator.R
mm_calculator_ui.Rd

Separate from mm_calculator() so that what a clinician is offered can be checked without a browser: a dropdown must contain the levels the model was developed on and no others.

Usage

mm_calculator_ui(
  model,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  threshold = NULL,
  subject = "patient",
  drawn = NULL,
  audience = c("clinician", "self"),
  gates = list()
)

Arguments

model

A mm_model().

title

The heading, or NULL for the default.

subtitle

The line under it, or NULL for the default.

threshold

The risk the bands are relative to.

subject

What one row is, in the singular.

drawn

The output of mm_calculator_nomogram(), or NULL.

audience

Who the page is written for.

gates

Inputs another input switches off, already normalised by mm_calculator_gates().

Value

A Shiny UI definition.
